map.从一顶点把正 n 边形分成 n−2 个三角形，每个内角和 180°，故内角和=(: From one vertex a regular n-gon splits into n-2 triangles, each summing to 180 degrees, so the interior sum is (n-2)·180 degrees; all angles are equal in a regular polygon, so dividing by n gives each interior angle.

map.正（凸）多边形内角恒 <180°，n→∞ 时趋近 180°（逼近圆）。内角 ≥1: Regular (convex) polygons always have interior angles <180 degrees, approaching 180 degrees as n grows (nearing a circle). Interior angles >=180 degrees belong to concave / star polygons, to which this formula does not apply.
